title: Working on a hexa island builder with Opus
author: Old-Wolverine-4134
selftext:
All build with Opus 5.5 over many dozens of prompts. Still no working title, but have the basic look and mechanics for the game. Next I will work on the economy side of things.

The idea is simple - you have a single castaway on small island. Gradually you make it bigger, gather resources and when you reach the lighthouse, another castaway finds his way to the island. In future will add more terrain types, more objectives, weather changes and so on.

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: Will do. It's hard to balance economy, objectives and the whole goal of the game. If anyone got ideas, I appreciate it.

replies.author: Blake9712
replies.body:
Hmmmm how about a dynamic trading system where the more goods added into the market the lower the value but the more goods pulled from the market the higher there value? Or I suppose that wouldn’t work well with the whole stranded vibe cause I’m thinking of additional npc islands. Maybe just more systems like the light house? A hunger, and sleep system if you don’t have that? Perhaps some woods tiles can secretly contain something like wolves and a villager defense system could work? Perhaps eventually you can build a dock or pier system that allows you to travel to ever expanding ai islands?

These are all just random bad spit ball ideas from someone with no knowledge of your project but I think that it sounds cool.

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: I already have the idea for wild animals that would pose a threat to the islanders. Also there will be more lighthouses and may be the first goal will be to build a boat that will take the islanders to new lands and adventures.

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: Here's my idea, take or leave it. Each day/night cycle refreshes your hand. you have a limited number of actions that you can take per day such as gather food, wood, stone, etc. If tiles provide benefits  when placed next to certain types that can create so pressure in deciding where and what to build.

replies.author: Upbeat-Strain-7999
replies.body: the lighthouse as the population gate is a really elegant anchor for the economy, because it gives you a clear thing to save toward instead of just accumulating numbers. I'd tie each new castaway to a real cost bump too, so growth feels like a decision rather than a free reward.

replies.author: gholias
replies.body: Did you manually work on Blender or AI did the job? Im asking because this is awesome dude.

replies.author: Old-Wolverine-4134
replies.body: All done by AI. As the game is viewed zoomed out most of the time - the models for the characters and the animals are not so detailed because it's not needed. The mountains, forests and stones are procedural. Mountains connect and form random bigger mountains. In the forests each tree can be cut down individually until no trees left on the tile. To create crop field, the tile should be next to a river. To get river you need at lest 2 mountain tiles next to each other.
